title: Undergraduate Academic Calendar 2026/2027
text:
AR338
Current Issues in Classical Archaeology
0.5 Credit
Hours per week:
Lecture/Discussion: 3
This
course
aims to provide a critical assessment of contemporary issues of interest in Classical Archaeology. The focus of the course will vary from
term
to term but the overarching goal is to provide
students
with up-to-date perspectives on theoretical and methodological discussions that are focused on obtaining a better understanding of the art and archaeology of the Greco-Roman world.
